title: code-mode-only probes should not expose direct file edit tools
wanted_capability: When a dispatch is code_mode=only and the recipe requires edits.apply, direct file mutation tools such as file_edit should be hidden or denied so probes cannot bypass hash-anchored edit sets and tree-sitter validation.
missing_primitive: Code-mode-only edit discipline enforcement for direct file_edit/file-write tools
fallback_used: The orchestrator detected the violation in the probe transcript and recorded it as protocol friction after the fact.
evidence: crates/bro-harness/src/code_mode.rs CodeMode::Only / defers_builtins: only demotes flat builtins to the deferred tier; they stay tool_search-loadable and callable
crates/bro-harness/src/registry.rs Registry::with_options: defer_builtins changes tier, never admission
crates/bro-harness/src/agent_loop.rs cm_callable: the exec callable set mirrors the filtered builtins, so file_edit/file_write/apply_patch are also reachable from inside exec
notes: Generic finding from a private Java extraction reprobe. The prompt explicitly required all edits through edits.apply, but the bro still used direct file_edit to patch a helper signature after a compile failure.
